objective: Ejecutar de forma idempotente el resync historico completo SoftRestaurant exclusivamente para ESTELAR, ahora que su dry-run individual fue CERTIFIED_OPERATIONAL al 100%. Usar solamente la capability cerrada SOFTRESTAURANT_FULL_HISTORY_RESYNC con --execute interno fijo. No aceptar shell, script_path arbitrario, rutas externas ni comandos adicionales. queries.name: target_tables_exist_after_estelar_write
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id WHERE s.name = 'dbo' AND t.name IN ('Finanzas_CortesCaja','Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos') ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: cortes_count_after_estelar_write
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja;

queries.name: detalle_pagos_count_after_estelar_write
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos;
